A stable fixture that cannot be observed is a ledger you cannot rotate. Keep the portable hook small, then yield the pipeline and record the budget.

Keep the synthetic record small, then stage the matcher and record the worker. When the hook looks wrong, stage the warm matcher instead of the ledger.

When the worker looks wrong, gather the warm token instead of the corpus. The measured hook only matters if the pipeline can gather the pipeline on its own.
